svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a beat whose harvest holds each value it proved and the state it left; beat 1: its row renders → the proof cell is already looping — no media mode to pick, no play to press — opening on the When in motion, not on the state the Given row already showed, framed tight on the thing being proven, with the whole frame exactly one toggle away; beat 2: you switch the reader's play control from auto to step → every loop holds where it is, and each beat row's own guided-tour stepper `‹ n / N ›` — or the ← → keys on the focused row — walks that beat one scene, both cells moving together, the next chevron becoming a restart `↺` at the last scene that wraps to the first; beat 3: the row is the Given → its one frame stays a still: a state, not an action
